findings.title: Checker still authorizes semantic governance and security violations

location.symbol: Automated checks and deterministic checker contract

findings.observation: The checker closes every previously enumerated instance, but it still parses several mandatory surfaces from raw Markdown substrings or omits them entirely. Hidden canonical tables/transitions/authority text, forged acceptance summaries, placeholder Must gates, contradictory NextStep, embedded ledgers, common credential-key variants, output paths inside the repository and spoofed link targets can all evade the intended check.
findings.trigger: An invalid package preserves recognized raw tokens or the first canonical structure, places the authority structure in non-rendered Markdown, mutates an unparsed governance table/field, uses a common prefixed credential key, or points checker output at a tracked input.
findings.impact: The required checker returns exit 0, overall PASS, all 13 checks PASS and a reproducible digest for content that violates single-authority, acceptance, traceability, visibility and security contracts; a mis-invocation can also overwrite a tracked input after the clean check. The envelope therefore cannot authorize merge.

evidence.description: PM-REQ-005 through PM-REQ-017, PM-AC-001 and PM-AC-006 through PM-AC-011, design sections 7 and 11, and implementation-plan lines 245-310 define the affected authority, parity, structure, link and secret gates.

The exact-head positive result and supplied 35-invalid plus two-error summary reproduce byte-identically with SHA-256 a0dacaa60b48479aca0ce3d1a72d41c65e621a632e8429bd2360712e31758fae and 424e355dee72f0004fef61fcbca08b30169e3a282953e25feb3167f49bb281b7.

The primary eight-fixture suite shows code-fence/comment-only canonical structures, summary NextStep contradiction, an embedded parallel ledger and a prefixed token assignment all receiving 13/13 PASS.

The independent fresh-context audit demonstrates explicit Review-authority contradiction, forged/duplicate acceptance summaries, a TBD Must checklist, link and credential bypasses, unsafe output overwrite and a harness mutation survivor.

findings.remediation: Build one visibility-aware, cardinality-aware parsed document model and validate canonical structures only from rendered content. Parse the acceptance summary and PlanId-bound Must checklist; compare summary NextStep with each plan; reject embedded secondary ledgers; canonicalize exact portfolio link targets; recognize common credential-key variants across all tracked text formats with redacted diagnostics; reject output paths inside the repository and recheck cleanliness after writing. Strengthen the harness with precise mutation-specific diagnostics and every reproduced case.
findings.verification: At a new exact live head, valid content must retain byte-stable 13/13 PASS. Every primary and independent invalid fixture must exit 1 with overall FAIL and the intended mutation-specific diagnostic without disclosing credential values; output-path misuse must emit ERROR without changing tracked files; deleting each detailed validator must make the harness fail; refreshed PR digests must bind the new artifacts before re-review.
